m.english: He did his work, received his meal and bed, just like all the men here.

m.english: His room was small but clean, and the food was good.

m.target: Je ok brát si jídlo do letadla?

u.english: I can stop and get lunch if you want.

u.english: You know, we don't have to be anywhere today, so I'll bring up some food in a little bit, and everything's gonna be fine.
